messages:
jonathan: Hey team — invoice preview for tenant 1234 is showing ~-15 credits vs live. graph: https://console.redwood.ai/d/tenant-1234/preview-vs-live (jump to last 6h)
sarah: I spotted the same. preview pipeline and finalizer disagree on sampling. preview looks like 10% but finalizer applied 13% after yesterday's deploy
kevin: which deploy changed sampling? any commit/PR link?
jonathan: deploy-bot: Deploy recorded: route-enrich-service @ v2.3.1 -> config change: sampling default bumped to 0.13 (PR #3892)
maria: FYI preview path reads route_meta.sample_rate, finalizer reads route_tag.sampling_override if present. we intended them to converge but the migration never shipped for preview
sarah: here's the config snippet from the deployed image:
```yaml
default_sample_rate: 0.13
apply_to: [finalizer, realtime]
routes:
  - id: route-priority
    sampling_override: 0.13
```
kevin: ok that's the mismatch. preview still falls back to default 0.10 in code: `if not route_meta.sample_rate -> 0.10`
ingest-bot: alert: sampling-config-mismatch triggered for tenant=1234, delta=18% between preview and finalizer
jonathan: proposal: quick mitigation = revert finalizer's default to 0.10 so preview and finalizer align, then ship a short migration that makes preview read sampling_override when present
maria: +1. I'll open a PR to add a dual-read fallback for 24h canary (preview checks both keys). will add unit tests.
kevin: I'll do the canary deployment and monitor invoice-preview delta. if >2% credits drift in 1h, rollback. setting Grafana alert now.
sarah: also we should surface a console banner when route-level sampling differs between preview and finalizer for any tenant (helps SRE/customer support)
jonathan: agree — ticket for console UX banner + link to docs. i'll tag product and billing.
maria: assigning tasks: PR (me), canary (kevin), backfill/replay job (jonathan to open with billing-team).
kevin: starting canary (route-enrich-service: v2.3.2-canary) now. will update in #eng-oncall if anything noisy :hourglass_flowing_sand:
sarah: thanks. also add a quick script to surface which tenants are impacted: `scripts/find_sampling_mismatch.py` — I'll push a gist in a sec.
jonathan: thanks all. short-term rollback if spike, long-term unify keys and add console guardrails. :thumbsup:
